chunks: And when Moses said to his people: 'Remember the favour of Allah upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with severe punishment, slaughtering your sons and keeping alive your women, and in that was a great trial from your Lord.'

key_terms.يَسُومُونَكُمْ: They deal with you / afflict you

ai.seo_question: What was the specific nature of Pharaoh's oppression against the Children of Israel as described in Surah Ibrahim?
ai.summary: In this verse, Moses reminds the Israelites of the specific divine favor in sparing their women while their men were slaughtered, a unique aspect of Pharaoh's tyranny that served as a profound trial (balā') from God. Shia exegetes often highlight this selective destruction as a test of patience and gratitude, emphasizing that the preservation of the women was not merely mercy but part of a greater divine plan for their eventual return to the Promised Land.
